verdict.rationale: Granola's own Chat can query all meetings at once, drawing on notes or transcripts, and its MCP lets connected AI tools search notes and transcripts. Separately, the magnifying glass beside each AI note shows where in the transcript or raw notes that point came from. Nothing documents a dedicated cross-meeting search that jumps from a result to the exact timestamped moment. Missing for 10: a documented search interface across transcripts, summaries and notes; jump-to-timestamp or playback from search results; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
Granola Chat lets you ask questions about your meetings and get instant insights from your notes or transcripts.
Use the magnifying glass beside each note to see where in the transcript or raw notes the note came from
Query your notes, search transcripts, and get meeting insights in your favorite AI assistants.
